summary: Lower general JavaScript remainder through a semantics helper when coercion or BigInt is possible.

target.notes: Apply ToNumeric to both operands and require matching Number/BigInt numeric kinds; preserve Number signed-zero behavior.

semantics.evaluation_order: left expression, right expression, then required coercions in specification order
semantics.coercion: Apply ToNumeric to both operands and require matching Number/BigInt numeric kinds; preserve Number signed-zero behavior.

caveats: Object coercion may invoke user-defined valueOf/toString/Symbol.toPrimitive with side effects or exceptions.
Symbol operands can make numeric/string coercion throw TypeError.
